idea: Two roommates wake up in a world where lying is physically impossible: every time someone tries to lie, the lights flicker and they sneeze uncontrollably.
instructions: Comedy. Fast, character-driven. Keep Main under 45 seconds, branches 25-35 seconds.
jokes:
One roommate asks the other: does this outfit look good?
The narrator also cannot lie.
events: The landlord knocks asking for overdue rent.
characters: Maya: confident, bad at hiding things. Theo: anxious, over-polite.
